New York: a $186 Amazon ring stamped 14K and sold as solid gold weighed 2.9 g and turned the testing acid green in two seconds, says jeweler Ezra Feldstein, 40 years on 47th Street.

On his bench it was brass under a yellow skin, about $1.50 of metal at his count, and the stamp inside was crisper than the one on an honest 10K band. Of the ten Amazon pieces he bought and tested with acid, magnet and scale, five were real and five were scams.

Video: Ezra Feldstein, YouTube, 22 October 2026.
